part.text: The data covers the full 2013–2025 range, and the pedestrian-fatality field is populated for these years. I’m using three supported views: yearly counts, pedestrians’ share of all recorded deaths, and yearly counts split by borough (with missing boroughs shown explicitly).

input.command: python3 -c "exec(\"import duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt\\nfrom pathlib import Path\\nPath('out').mkdir(exist_ok=True)\\ndb=duckdb.connect()\\nsource='data/crashes.parquet'\\nannual=db.execute(\\\"SELECT year(crash_date) AS year, sum(number_of_pedestrians_killed)::BIGINT AS pedestrian_deaths, sum(number_of_persons_killed)::BIGINT AS all_person_deaths FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE year(crash_date) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1\\\", [source]).df()\\nyears=pd.DataFrame({'year': range(2013,2026)})\\nannual=years.merge(annual,on='year',how='left').fillna(0)\\nannual[['year','pedestrian_deaths','all_person_deaths']]=annual[['year','pedestrian_deaths','all_person_deaths']].astype(int)\\nannual['pedestrian_share_of_all_deaths_pct']=100*annual.pedestrian_deaths/annual.all_person_deaths\\nannual[['year','pedestrian_deaths']].to_csv('out/values_1.csv',index=False)\\nfig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5.5))\\nbars=ax.bar(annual.year,annual.pedestrian_deaths,color='#286b9e',width=.72)\\nax.bar_label(bars,padding=3,fontsize=9)\\nax.set(title='Pedestrians killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes, 2013–2025',xlabel='Crash year',ylabel='Pedestrians killed')\\nax.set_xticks(annual.year); ax.set_ylim(0, max(annual.pedestrian_deaths)*1.16); ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.25); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig('out/option_1.png',dpi=160); plt.close(fig)\\nannual[['year','pedestrian_deaths','all_person_deaths','pedestrian_share_of_all_deaths_pct']].to_csv('out/values_2.csv',index=False,float_format='%.2f')\\nfig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5.5))\\nax.plot(annual.year,annual.pedestrian_share_of_all_deaths_pct,marker='o',linewidth=2.2,color='#b45137')\\nfor x,y in zip(annual.year,annual.pedestrian_share_of_all_deaths_pct): ax.annotate(f'{y:.1f}%',(x,y),xytext=(0,8),textcoords='offset points',ha='center',fontsize=8)\\nax.set(title='Pedestrians’ share of all people killed in NYC crashes, 2013–2025',xlabel='Crash year',ylabel='Pedestrian deaths / all recorded deaths (%)')\\nax.set_xticks(annual.year); ax.set_ylim(0,max(annual.pedestrian_share_of_all_deaths_pct)*1.2); ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.25); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig('out/option_2.png',dpi=160); plt.close(fig)\\nby_borough=db.execute(\\\"SELECT year(crash_date) AS year, coalesce(nullif(trim(borough), ''), 'Unknown') AS borough, sum(number_of_pedestrians_killed)::BIGINT AS pedestrian_deaths FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE year(crash_date) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2025 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2\\\", [source]).df()\\nall_years=pd.MultiIndex.from_product([range(2013,2026),sorted(by_borough.borough.unique())],names=['year','borough']).to_frame(index=False)\\nby_borough=all_years.merge(by_borough,on=['year','borough'],how='left').fillna({'pedestrian_deaths':0})\\nby_borough['pedestrian_deaths']=by_borough.pedestrian_deaths.astype(int)\\nby_borough.to_csv('out/values_3.csv',index=False)\\nwide=by_borough.pivot(index='year',columns='borough',values='pedestrian_deaths')\\norder=['MANHATTAN','BROOKLYN','QUEENS','BRONX','STATEN ISLAND','Unknown']\\nwide=wide[[b for b in order if b in wide.columns]]\\ncolors=['#286b9e','#e08a39','#72a66a','#bb6573','#8b76ab','#aaaaaa']\\nfig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,6))\\nwide.plot(kind='bar',stacked=True,ax=ax,color=colors[:len(wide.columns)],width=.8)\\nax.set(title='Pedestrians killed by recorded borough in NYC crashes, 2013–2025',xlabel='Crash year',ylabel='Pedestrians killed')\\nax.legend(title='Borough',ncol=3,loc='upper center',bbox_to_anchor=(.5,-.12),frameon=False)\\nax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.2); ax.set_axisbelow(True); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig('out/option_3.png',dpi=160,bbox_inches='tight'); plt.close(fig)\\nprint(annual.to_string(index=False)); print('borough totals\\\\n',by_borough.groupby('borough').pedestrian_deaths.sum().sort_values(ascending=False).to_string())\\n\")"
